data.description:
## Goal
Provide the evidence the LP-0MU1S617L002Q9PR audit requires to close AC1 and AC2, via a reproducible verification tool plus the 24 h AC1 window definition. Producer decisions are already recorded (2026-10-13, in comments): AC2 re-scoped to warm-cache local dispatches p99 < 60 s to first byte plus a queue-wait cap; AC1 24 h window starts at the next timed proxy restart once the AC1 ceiling fix (4e8970e0) is deployed (live since 12:05:55; proxy restarted 15:48:19 local → candidate window 2026-10-13 15:48 → 2026-10-14 15:48).

## Scope
1. **Reproducible verification tool** (`scripts/dispatch_latency_verification.py`): scans proxy logs over a window and reports AC1 surfaces (dispatch_first_byte_timeout with ceiling split 900s vs 840s; chain-hold starts; client queue-timeout relays) and the re-scoped AC2 metric (warm/cold first-byte service time + queue wait, p50/p90/p99), with a PASS/WARN verdict and JSON output.
2. **Post-deploy evidence artifact** committed under `docs/dev/dispatch-latency-post-deploy-2026-10-13.json` (AC1 zero legacy-900s ceilings live; AC2 warm p99 measured 307.6 s — target not yet demonstrated, finding recorded).
3. **Documentation** (`docs/dev/dispatch-latency-verification.md`): window definition, metric semantics (incl. the llama-server-internal-serialisation gap in the AC2 proxy-side queue-wait split), reproducibility commands.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A tool in `scripts/dispatch_latency_verification.py` parses a proxy log corpus over a user-supplied window and reports AC1 (timeout count split by ceiling, chain-hold starts + held seconds, client queue-timeout relays) and AC2 (warm/cold first-byte service time + queue wait, p50/p90/p99), with JSON output.
- [ ] The tool's verdict evaluates the re-scoped targets: zero ceiling=900s AC1 events in-window; warm-cache service p99 < 60 s; returns PASS/WARN with exit code 0/2.
- [ ] Unit tests (synthetic log corpus, no production data) assert the metric contract: ceiling split, warm/cold split, queue-wait separation, window filtering, verdict logic, and gzip handling.
- [ ] A committed post-deploy evidence artifact plus documentation defining the AC1 24 h window (start/end, tool invocation with --window-closed) and recording the AC2 measurement finding.
- [ ] Full test suite green.

## Non-goals
- Changing proxy behaviour — the AC1 ceiling bound (LP-0MV6BR3HI00957PF) and AC2 metric segmentation (LP-0MV6CFMU9005WU2E) are already implemented and deployed.
- Closing the AC1 24 h window inside this session — it is inherently time-gated (window ends 2026-10-14 15:48 local); the tool + window definition make the closing measurement reproducible.
data.title: AC1 24 h post-change measurement and AC2 first-byte target decision
